`vod_chat.json` is a made-up 40-minute chat replay in TwitchDownloaderCLI's
`chatdownload` JSON layout (`comments[].content_offset_seconds`,
`comments[].message.body`). About 4 messages per 10 seconds of ordinary chat,
plus three bursts of emotes peaking around 15:08, 25:08 and 35:08. Made by a
seeded script, so it never changes. No real usernames or messages.
